instruction: Use Woodpecker JSON log output for build
output: woodpecker-cli build logs owner/repo 42 1 --output json

instruction: Use Drone with custom CA certificate
output: export DRONE_SKIP_VERIFY=true && drone --server https://drone.internal build ls owner/repo

instruction: Use Woodpecker with self-signed certificates
output: export WOODPECKER_SKIP_VERIFY=true && woodpecker-cli build ls owner/repo

instruction: Use Drone with Gitea OAuth2 config
output: export DRONE_GITEA_SERVER=https://git.example.com && export DRONE_GITEA_CLIENT_ID=xxx && export DRONE_GITEA_CLIENT_SECRET=yyy

instruction: Use Woodpecker with Gitea client
output: export WOODPECKER_GITEA_URL=https://git.example.com && export WOODPECKER_GITEA_CLIENT=xxx && export WOODPECKER_GITEA_SECRET=yyy

instruction: Use Drone with admin registration via env
output: export DRONE_USER_CREATE=username:admin,machine:false,admin:true

instruction: Use Woodpecker with admin user registration
output: export WOODPECKER_ADMIN=admin_username

instruction: Create a Drone pipeline with detached debug container
output: echo 'steps: - name: debug image: alpine detach: true commands: - sleep 3600 - name: test image: alpine commands: - wget http://debug:8080' >> .drone.yml

instruction: Use Drone pipeline with settings from_secret
output: echo 'steps: - name: build image: plugins/docker settings: password: from_secret: DOCKER_PASSWORD' >> .drone.yml

instruction: Use Woodpecker with settings from secret
output: echo 'pipeline: build: image: plugins/docker settings: password: from_secret: DOCKER_PASSWORD' > .woodpecker.yml

instruction: Use Drone with deployment service (Kubernetes runner)
output: echo 'kind: pipeline type: kubernetes name: deploy steps: - name: apply image: alpine commands: - kubectl apply -f k8s/' > .drone.yml

instruction: Use Drone with custom Kubernetes namespace
output: echo 'kind: pipeline type: kubernetes name: deploy metadata: namespace: production steps: - name: apply image: alpine commands: - kubectl apply -f k8s/' > .drone.yml

instruction: Use Drone debug webhook payloads
output: drone build ls owner/repo --page 1 --per-page 1 && drone build info owner/repo 1

instruction: Use Woodpecker debug YAML parsing
output: woodpecker-cli build info owner/repo 42 --output yaml

instruction: Use Drone cron job with specific branch
output: drone cron create owner/repo weekly '@weekly' --branch main

instruction: Use Drone build with specific commit SHA
output: drone build queue owner/repo --commit abc123 --branch main --param PARAM=value

instruction: Use Drone with custom env in build queue
output: drone build queue owner/repo --param FOO=bar --param BAZ=qux

instruction: Use Drone CLI without a TTY (script mode)
output: drone --no-color build ls owner/repo

instruction: Use Woodpecker CLI without color
output: woodpecker-cli --no-color build ls owner/repo

instruction: Use Drone global runner configuration
output: export DRONE_RUNNER_VOLUMES=/tmp/cache:/tmp/cache && docker run -d drone/drone-runner-docker:1

instruction: Use Drone runner with specific labels
output: docker run -d drone/drone-runner-docker:1 -e DRONE_RUNNER_LABELS=region:us-east,zone:a

instruction: Use Drone with pipeline environment as file
output: echo 'steps: - name: env-dump image: alpine commands: - env' >> .drone.yml

instruction: Use Woodpecker with Cron job YAML status check
output: woodpecker-cli cron ls owner/repo --output json

instruction: Use Drone with custom build timeout
output: export DRONE_TIMEOUT=30m && drone build start owner/repo 42

instruction: Use Woodpecker agent with custom capacity
output: export WOODPECKER_MAX_PROCS=4 && woodpecker-agent
